title: Measure and bound failure-card growth while a persistent bind failure is retried inside the admission window
outcome: While a queue head's bind keeps failing (deadline_exceeded with the circuit opening, or control_store_busy), its automatic bind retry runs inside the 240 s admission window. A w-ac230a24d0d8 test (persistent_bind_failures_end_at_the_budget_with_their_exact_identity, run test-393027da on 8cfc5739 plus that change) counted 65 Engram control cards for 7 session_bind requests in the deadline_exceeded case. So cards appear on ticks that send no bind, probably when the open circuit or backoff defers the attempt or postpones the bind retry. The test drives a scripted clock in a 64-iteration loop, so the ratio may overstate the live 2 s tick. A live or clock-faithful measurement is needed first: count the cards per minute for a head whose bind keeps failing. If they repeat without a new attempt, post at most one card per real attempt and keep the hold readable.
acceptance: While a queue head's bind keeps failing inside its admission window, TermAl posts at most one failure card per session_bind it actually sends; an automatic retry step that sends no bind adds no card. A test driving a persistent bind failure records each step's binds and cards and asserts this.

The full five-stage gate passes on the exact committed tree, and an independent read-only review pair of different vendors (Codex and Claude, or Kimi standing in for one unavailable reviewer under the commit rule) has no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
